# [Experiment] E-B300-PR4-AGE-SUCCESSOR-V1: per-field versus grouped causal age

1. **Status, lineage and owner.** Cold-start successor of PR4, owned by SemyonEpanov/root tabdata execution. Parent https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/4. Implementation reuses native source features; this separate six-epoch experiment does not execute the original cache/teacher/warm proposal. Profile, smoke, production fit and grade statuses are recorded separately.
2. **Why it should work.** Group clocks can hide asynchronous field updates. Candidate field_age versus group_age control, both append112 age channels:323 total inputs and2267650 parameters. Control broadcasts seven group ages to the same112 width; model/budget/prior ancestry are matched. Predicted observation is paired WP gain from finer staleness information, rather than added capacity. Strong alternative: grouped clocks regularize sparse/noisy age; consistent field-age harm would support it. Causal scanning and sequence resets are source tested. Current streaming graph does not support either age mode: a score here cannot establish a valid serving artifact.

3. **Compute advantage.** Full-data, full-context independent fits test whether a richer causal representation improves the same deployable-size GRU. This is a student representation experiment, with no teacher. Additional seeds measure optimization variability; 30 is the team replication contract, not a demonstrated power calculation. Other PRs and larger teachers remain independent opportunities.
4. **Frozen comparison.** Canonical trainer a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d; cold H512, one GRU layer, labels only, strict FP32 (autocast, scaler and TF32 off), batch8, chunk2000, six full epochs; fixed epoch5, no validation during fitting. AdamW lr0.0001, beta2=0.999, wd0.01, OneCycle warmup0.05, clip1, dropout0, seeded batches, deterministic flags and fused Adam. Existing raw112+event99 inputs remain. No initialization, distillation, quantization or selected-best checkpoint. Original four split manifests and full training membership are unchanged. This differs from the upstream warm/teacher/12-epoch proposal and is NOT its completion. No automatic resume or scientific retry.
5. **Thirty paired runs.** Each arm uses F0/F1 seeds1101..1108, F2/F3 seeds1101..1107: 8/8/7/7, 30 per arm, 60 fits per experiment. Pair seed/fold and same GPU for the two arms. Seeds differ from exposed external and existing R01/PR15 campaigns. All four folds are already exposed; fresh seeds do not make them new test data. Engineering profiles and smoke fits contribute zero cells.
6. **Validation and significance.** Unchanged pinned official weighted-Pearson grader (SHA256 56ffc693da52668726bab1f7008e31753a76aed3ff5d79089167785079d9eb31), same held-out complete components and original mask/weights. Primary effect is the equally weighted mean candidate-minus-control WP over the 30 paired cells; retain fold and seed effects. Per-cell component bootstrap2000 describes fixed-model evaluation uncertainty, not independent training replications. Overlapping fold training and shared components prevent interpreting 30 scores as 30 independent datasets. Final analysis must separately report seed variation, fold effects, component sensitivity and both feature families' multiplicity. No unqualified p-value from pooled rows or claim of confirmed public transfer.
7. **Leakage and coverage.** Full component exclusions from the original manifests, full sequence causal history, feature-only heldout loading, no future label input and no teacher/initializer ancestor. Fitting-only normalization; reset sequence state between sequences. Saved source, memberships, feature prior and checkpoint identities must match actual producer schemas. Known limitation: exposed four-fold validation and no new market regime. Offline causal features are not proof of serving compatibility.
8. **Decision-changing result.** A mean WP gain of at least0.001 is a predeclared engineering priority for serving integration, conditional on consistency across folds/seeds, uncertainty and runtime. This threshold is not a power claim or automatic promotion. Smaller/noisy gains motivate residual/blend or larger-scale checks if mechanism evidence warrants; consistent harm deprioritizes this frozen recipe. An interval crossing zero alone does not close the direction. No public score projection.
9. **How to run.** Root /data/epanov_s/tabdata, existing .venv Python3.12/Torch2.14.0+cu130 on eight B300s, same single SSH operator. Canonical source runtime/source-a266-lf-subset-v1 and unchanged runtime/b300-r01-v1 + runtime/pr15-host-v2 helpers. New runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/config.json pins the panel, source, all Python members, density receipt and actual GitHub target IDs. Launch .venv/bin/python -B -u runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/code/feature_controller.py --config runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/config.json --config-sha256 25df31865445eadd431529998873a9a1fccf330bc433b65c7313e3d37e73d326, inside the dedicated finite user systemd unit tabdata-native-feature-execution-v1. MemoryMax192GiB, swap0, TasksMax1024, CPU80..167; at most five campaign CUDA fits per GPU, preserving two R01 and two PR15 reservations until canonical terminal receipts AND inactive empty owners prove release. Initial one new fit/GPU, maximum three new/GPU after release, no foreign process changes. Maximum20h per fit and168h campaign. Failure preserves its attempt and pauses that family; an export problem never triggers a refit. Exact commands, config hash and actual startup belong in observed receipts.
10. **Evidence to return.** Immutable source/config/split/tree identities, requested and observed feature settings, FP32 flags, UUID/CPU/resource envelope, complete six-epoch history/loss/LR/preclip gradients/attempted and completed updates, canonical epoch5 tensor equality, prediction sidecar/bytes/finite shape, unchanged official grade and paired bootstrap. Store all failures. Separate evidence and weights archives with SHA256/private server paths, no raw dataset or secret in GitHub. Report progress every10min and scored completions through an independent CPU reporter; it cannot train or change recipes.
11. **Results and trace.** Preparation is not a measured gain. See parallel_expansion_v1/README.md and its observed receipts for actual profile/smoke/startup stages; only scored paired endpoints count as evaluated comparisons. The full panel is120 newly proposed fits across these two independent experiments. Original #15/#25 remain distinct and continue unchanged. Source-qualified upstream contracts and independent critiques are in this packet. Do not merge or mark upstream PRs completed automatically.

Actual execution: [RUN_STATUS.md](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/tabdata-native-age-cp30/research/campaign_2026-10-18/b300_execution_r1/parallel_expansion_v1/RUN_STATUS.md), [portfolio review](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/tabdata-native-age-cp30/research/campaign_2026-10-18/b300_execution_r1/parallel_expansion_v1/PORTFOLIO_REVIEW.md), immutable config and observed receipts. This successor currently has4 active scientific fits and0 scored pairs; the shared120-fit controller initially runs8 extra fits across8B300 alongside32 existing fits.
